description: Independent Astra and Claude bilingual editions, with Sol research and separate review.

articles.model: GPT-6 Astra Medium · Sol source/completeness review
articles.availability_note: Source review follows the November19,2026 Physical Review Letters paper and NASA/AEI reports. The discovery uses fifteen years of older Fermi data. About ten CPU hours found this isolated pulsar; the earlier semicoherent search failed after roughly600 CPU years. This is a case-specific computing comparison, with random-subset searches, background rejection and larger-data confirmation. Binary-system discoveries remain prospective. The open paper and code links support checking; this review did not rerun the benchmark or establish independent replication.
